title: 5 Open Source AI Tools That Could Replace Paid Apps
description:
Five open source AI tools for coding, local voice, SEO and AI agents.
Free guide: https://withhammad.com/resources/five-open-source-ai-repos

1. OpenCode — an open-source coding agent, with selected free models.
2. VoiceStudio — a local ElevenLabs alternative for your own voice.
3. OpenSEO — keywords, rankings, backlinks and audits.
4. OpenMausBot — AI teammates with your choice of supported engine.
5. Replica — 11 skills to study features, rebuild and improve them with your own branding.

Free code does not make every service free: OpenCode's free-model availability changes, OpenSEO uses paid DataForSEO data, and model/compute costs still apply. VoiceStudio is an independent alternative to ElevenLabs.

AI avatar of me, using my own ElevenLabs voice clone. Visual reference and product inserts: @nick_saraev.
Documentation checked 8 November 2026.

Subscribe, then comment REPO for the five links and setup guide.
